with.help: Who is invited: names or emails, separated by commas

no_reply.label: No reply needed
no_reply.description: Nothing to answer: an FYI, already handled, or the member answered outside Hivenod.

reason.label: Why
reason.help: One line on why no answer is needed

make_it_work.label: Make it work (retired)
make_it_work.description: Retired with Projects (2026-10-30): never propose it. Propose a Development plan (plan_propose template dev) instead.

title.label: Item title
title.help: The work, as an item title

brief.label: Brief
brief.help: What is asked, by whom, and what done looks like

handover.label: Hand over
handover.description: Loop in someone else, or another organization's agent.

snooze.label: Snooze
snooze.description: Come back to it later: the thread waits until the date, then wakes up.

nudge.label: Nudge
nudge.description: They have not answered for a while: a short reminder.

text.label: Nudge
text.help: The reminder, ready to send as written

ignore.label: Ignore
ignore.description: Not for the member: spam, noise, not theirs.

shape.label: Shape
shape.description: Development, step 1: research the idea, write the proposal into the summary (ask: build this?), attach drafts, give the size S/M/L.

idea.label: Idea
idea.help: What is to be built, as the member asked it

build.label: Build
build.description: Development: build what the approved idea says in a worktree; end with an open pull request, local checks green, NOT merged (Release merges it). Report the PR link and what changed.

brief.label: Brief
brief.help: What to build (default: what Approve idea approved)

keepgreen.label: Keep green
keepgreen.description: Development: keep the open pull request green and current with main: rebase it when main moves, rerun the local checks, fix failures, until it is green and up to date (report done: Ship it? is offered). While Ship it? waits, re-green it whenever main moves (step_progress check rechecking, then green). Unsolvable (a conflict that needs a product decision, the same check failing after 3 fixes, an infrastructure failure): report failed with the evidence.

release.label: Release + live check
release.description: Development: merge the approved pull request(s), run the release checks, release, check it live; report the merge sha, release number, live commit, production URL and screenshots.

their_reply.label: Their reply
their_reply.description: A plan step that waits on one person outside Hivenod (a client, a supplier) reached by a message: at its turn draft the ask in the member's voice with step_ask (nothing is sent before the member approves it), send it, report step_sent; their reply wakes you (external_reply): a clear yes is outcome_done with evidence (the inbound messageId and the quote), anything else a follow-up step_ask. One person per step.

channel.label: Channel
channel.help: Where you reach them: mail, teams, slack… (one you can send on)

address.label: Address
address.help: Their address or handle on that channel

need.label: Need
need.help: One line: what we need from them

remindAfterDays.label: Remind after (working days)
remindAfterDays.help: Working days without a reply before one reminder is drafted, 1-30 (default 3)

approval.label: Your approval
approval.description: A plan step for the member: a gate they decide before the next steps run. Put one before anything that changes money, prices, contracts or public content. Never carried out by an agent.

what.label: What you approve
what.help: One line: what the member approves

detail.label: Detail
detail.help: The change, e.g. old → new prices

link.label: Link
link.help: Where to look, an http(s) link
